selection_notes: 150 real SKILL.md files selected across seven maintainers. Category and working/output traits are editorial inferences from source instructions, not quality measurements. Exact body copies are excluded. No source body is executed or mirrored. Anthropic proprietary document skills are excluded. No license is inferred when a selected directory lacks explicit terms. Install compatibility records instruction portability, not successful execution in every environment. Companion-dependent workflows use source setup without a standalone command.
